roleLabel: Crit-control Mage — Starfall snipes that permanent-scale Magic on kills
bestFor: Runs that can feed her kills and Crit so Starfall also stuns the board
strength: On-kill permanent Magic and on-Crit AoE Stun turn every successful cast into tempo and long-run scaling
weakness: Feels weak without kills or Crit; she is not a pure forever-DoT Mage like Funke/Aria

howToPlay.early: Pick her when you can secure kills (execute help, focus fire). Buy Magic and Crit tools; protect the backline cast.
howToPlay.mid: Fashionable = item-slot scaling from rarities. Ostentatious = team Magic/Mana Regen on cast (Mage/Mystic Backup). Magnanimous = extra lowest-HP hits plus Stealth/on-kill scaling. Choose inventory greed, team amp, or execute carry.
howToPlay.late: Keep getting kills so Magic snowballs. Crit relics unlock the stun clause — do not ignore Crit entirely.
howToPlay.positioning: Classic backline. Magnanimous wants her alive for repeated casts; do not let dive cancel Starfall.

abilityNotes.Starfall: Kill = permanent Magic. Crit = board Stun. Play for clean-up and Crit chance, not only raw Magic.

specNotes.The Fashionable: Take when you will fill her item slot with real rarities — empty slot is a dead branch.
specNotes.The Ostentatious: Team Mage/Mystic amp path. Take with multiple casters; weaker as solo Ratna.
specNotes.The Magnanimous: Execute/carry path — multi-hit lowest HP and kill stealth. Best when she is the finisher.

relicReasons.mages-enlightenment-banner-601: Caster tempo banner for repeated Starfalls.
relicReasons.mages-cataclysm-engine-4006: Mage power engine for the nuke identity.
relicReasons.mages-flowing-reflection-634: Supports cast/flow play patterns around Starfall.

faq.question: Is Ratna good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: High ceiling when she farms kills and Crit. Low impact if she never finishes units. Buy her as a scaling sniper, not an early spray Mage.

faq.question: What class is Ratna?
faq.answer: Mage. Role focus: Crit-control caster with permanent Magic on kill.

faq.question: What relics work with Ratna?
faq.answer: Mage Enlightenment/Cataclysm pieces, Crit tools, and Arcane amplifiers.

faq.question: How do you play Ratna?
faq.answer: Protect casts, aim for kills, add Crit for stuns, and pick Magnanimous for carry or Ostentatious for team Mage boards.

tips: If she never gets kills, add execute/focus — more Magic alone will not start the snowball.
Fashionable without items is a no; loot first, then take the spec.
